blocks.title: No. 76: 漫画 / 故事板 - Yukata Character Sheet Generator
blocks.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a realistic character sheet for a specific person wearing different colored yukatas. It handles multiple views (front, side, back) and ensures character and hairstyle consistency based on a reference image.
blocks.prompt:
[Final Product Objective] Using the attached female full-body reference image as the sole subject reference, and the attached yukata reference image group, create a high-quality realistic character sheet of the same person wearing a yukata in a specified color scheme. The sheet should be visually appealing for sharing and practical for checking the person, yukata, obi, and face.
[Input Items]
Aspect Ratio: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1 / 9:16"}
Color Scheme Type: {argument name="color scheme" default="White / Indigo / Red"}
Defaults to 1:1 and White if not specified.
[Reference Usage]
Image A = 1 female full-body reference image. Sole person reference.
Image B = Reference for white color scheme. White to light base, pale cool-toned patterns, light obi.
Image C = Reference for indigo color scheme. Indigo base, white to light patterns, dark obi.
Image D = Main reference for red color scheme and common pattern structure. White to light base, red to dark red patterns, dark red obi.
Image E = Supplementary reference for back obi knot and footwear.
[Person Consistency]
Maintain the same person as Image A, preserving facial features, eyes, contours, nose, mouth, hairstyle, hair color, length, bangs, parting, age, skin tone, height, shoulder width, chest, torso length, waist position, curves, hip roundness, body type, proportions, and limb length. Maintain a natural, slender feminine 3D form and avoid shortening the torso or making it boxy/flat. Do not inherit clothing, background, or pose from the original image.
[Hairstyle Consistency]
Keep Image A's hairstyle consistent across all views. Forbidden: updos, bun styles, braids, adding hair ornaments, or different hairstyles for SIDE/BACK views. Keep hair tidy, avoiding messiness, spread, flyaways, wind-blown looks, or chaotic clustering. The back view must show natural hair flow, looking like the same person with the same hairstyle.
[Yukata Design]
All three color schemes use the same design with different colors. Fix the pattern structure using Image D as the main reference, only changing the base, pattern, and obi colors. Do not change the type of pattern, main floral designs, or streamline composition for different colors. Ensure natural collar alignment, sleeves, body, hem, and obi placement/wrapping for beautiful dressing. Sleeves and body should have a natural drape.
[Coloring]
White: Main reference Image B. White to light cream base, common pattern in pale cool colors like light blue/gray-blue, light blue obi. Cool and elegant.
Indigo: Main reference Image C. Indigo to dusty blue base, common pattern in white/light colors, navy to deep indigo obi. Calm and dignified.
Red: Main reference Image D. White to light cream base, common pattern in red to maroon, maroon to deep reddish-purple obi. Vibrant, mature, and elegant.
[Obi and Footwear]
The obi should be a half-width belt suitable for a yukata, firmly cinched at the waist. Do not unnaturally flatten the torso, and avoid a loose, cylindrical look. The BACK view must clearly show a natural knot shape based on Image E. Footwear should follow the shape and atmosphere of Image E.
[Fixed Layout]
Do not change the specified layout. Overall: Top section ~58%, Bottom section ~42%.
Top: 01 FRONT ~22% / 02 SIDE ~22% / 03 BACK ~22% / 04 SPECIAL LOOK ~34%.
Bottom: 05 FACE ~62% / 06 REFERENCE / DETAIL ~38%.
01-04 must include full body from head to footwear. 04 is a large 3/4 full-body view. 05 consists of 3 face shots: front, oblique 3/4, and light side. 06 is an auxiliary frame for checking obi, footwear, and patterns.
[02 SIDE Critical Condition]
Must be a clear full-body profile, not a stiff standing pose. The silhouette should transition smoothly from the natural forward volume of the chest to the cinched waist at the obi, light waist curve, and posterior hip roundness. Do not make the torso look like a cylinder or a flat board. Neck should be naturally long, shoulders relaxed, with a stable back and pelvis. Combine feminine 3D form with beautiful yukata fit.
[Text Rules]
The only allowed text is "01 FRONT", "02 SIDE", "03 BACK", "04 SPECIAL LOOK", "05 FACE", and "06 REFERENCE / DETAIL". Do not add Japanese notes, descriptions, footnotes, captions, comments, color explanations, or decorative text. Font, color, size, and tone of headers must be uniform.
[Background and Quality]
Background is white or very light neutral. Photorealistic, high quality, natural human body/face/hands/feet, no structural flaws in yukata/obi. Consistent identity, body type, and hairstyle across all views. Maintain layout for both 1:1 and 9:16, only adjusting margins and frame dimensions naturally.
[Prohibitions]
Person change, excessive beautification/rejuvenation/aging, small-face distortion, leg lengthening, body change, flattening, hairstyle change/mess, different patterns per color, loose obi causing cylindrical torso, turning it into a kimono/dress/cosplay, unauthorized text, busy backgrounds, information overload, extreme poses.
[Most Important]
Maintain Image A's identity, body type, and hairstyle across all views, and establish the Image D pattern in white, indigo, or red. Specifically, do not break the obi cinching, feminine profile, hair stability, or beautiful dressing.

Create a premium cinematic character design sheet for one single {argument name="character" default="alien male character"}.
Show the same character consistently in:
front view, left side view, right three quarter view, rear view, face close-up, full-body neutral stance, combat stance, angry expression, smug expression, confused comedic expression.
The character is a gigantic obese humanoid alien male, approximately seven feet tall, with an enormous rounded belly, thick chest, powerful arms, broad shoulders, thick legs, and very heavy physical weight.
His skin is {argument name="skin color" default="pale turquoise"} with subtle mottling and slightly rough alien texture. His head is large and heavy with a thick jaw, broad cheeks, very small intimidating eyes, a flattened alien nose, deep facial folds, and a smug heavy-lidded expression. No human facial hair.
His armor combines intimidating sci-fi warlord design with extravagant gangster luxury: dark graphite and gunmetal armored shoulder pieces, reinforced chest harness that leaves the large belly shape clearly readable, metallic waist plating, oversized lunar boots, gold rings, heavy chains, floating ornamental belt elements, and a few {argument name="energy color" default="glowing violet"} time-control devices embedded into his armor.
His silhouette must remain unmistakably huge and top-heavy.
Posture: relaxed confidence, belly forward, shoulders slightly back, chin raised. In combat he lowers his center of gravity and uses enormous sweeping arm movements.
Expression range:
arrogant grin
dismissive boredom
irritated disbelief
full rage
shocked comedic reaction
calculating menace
Power visual language:
subtle violet-white temporal energy around his hands, concentric distortion rings, suspended particles, warped light, small clock-like energy geometry without literal clock graphics.
Lighting:
clean neutral studio-style character lighting with a subtle cool lunar rim light. High detail on face, armor, skin texture, accessories, and silhouette.
Visual style:
photoreal cinematic sci-fi character design suitable for premium live-action AI video. Realistic anatomy, believable materials, readable costume construction, no cartoon proportions despite the comedic personality.
Continuity Notes
Preserve exactly:
same pale turquoise skin tone
same apparent age
same facial proportions
same tiny eye shape
same enormous belly and heavy body type
same armor design
same gold rings and chains
same floating belt ornaments
same lunar boots
same violet temporal-energy design
His size must remain dramatically larger than the woman in every shared frame.

No body slimming, no muscular bodybuilder transformation, no different face, no skin-color change, no random horns, no extra arms, no tentacles, no hairstyle, no beard, no armor redesign, no random helmet, no missing jewelry, no wardrobe drift, no duplicated character, no broken anatomy, no cartoon style, no watermark, no text.

blocks.title: No. 78: 漫画 / 故事板 - The Last Train From the Night Café
blocks.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for generating a rainy European station café scene filled with vintage details, passengers, signage, and warm nocturnal atmosphere.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a single coherent ultra-detailed photorealistic cinematic 16:9 image titled “THE LAST TRAIN FROM THE NIGHT CAFÉ,” set at exactly 21:47 on a rainy autumn night inside an elegant old European station café. The scene must be one continuous view, not a collage, split screen, or triptych.
Canvas and composition: Wide horizontal frame, viewed from just outside or at the open doorway of the café, looking inward and slightly right toward the adjacent train platform. Use deep perspective: wet glass and dark doorframes at the edges, a marble café table in the foreground center-left, warm café interior in the middle ground, and the blue rainy station platform visible through the open doors on the right. The atmosphere is melancholic, literary, and magical-real but still photorealistic.
Setting details: The café is called {argument name="café sign text" default="NACHTCAFÉ – LETZTER ZUG"}, shown on a large glowing cream sign above an ornate mirrored bar. Interior materials are dark polished wood, brass trim, antique mirrors, patterned wall tiles, marble tabletop, bentwood chairs, and glossy wet mosaic floor tiles. Rain streaks cover the windows and door glass, with red and blue city reflections outside. Warm globe pendant lamps hang from the ceiling; include exactly 5 visible round glowing globe lamps: 1 large lamp near the top left-center, 1 large lamp near the top center-right, 2 smaller hanging lamps near the timetable area, and 1 small lamp reflection/glow near the platform side. Add an antique wall clock above the timetable showing about 21:47.
Foreground characters and table: At the marble table sit exactly 2 café customers. Customer 1 is an elderly Black man in a textured brown tweed suit, white shirt, glasses, and gray beard, seated left in profile, writing in a cream notebook with a fountain pen. The notebook has legible handwritten text beginning “The future arrived seven minutes late.” Customer 2 is a pale red-haired woman in a dark emerald velvet coat seated center, gently pouring amber tea from a glass teapot into a white cup while holding a gold pocket watch. Give her a calm, wistful expression. On the table include exactly 6 main tabletop items: 1 open notebook, 1 fountain pen in the man’s hand, 1 glass teapot with amber tea, 2 white cups with saucers, and 1 small metal table-number stand displaying “12.” Under the table place exactly 1 black cat with bright eyes and a small white chest patch. Beside the table lean exactly 1 closed red umbrella with a curved handle.
Background figures and action: Include exactly 2 background human figures. One is a blurred café patron or staff reflection near the mirror/bar at left, partially turned away. The second is a female train conductor standing in the open doorway on the right, wearing a dark navy uniform and peaked cap, holding a ticket or sign. The ticket should read approximately {argument name="conductor ticket text" default="GLEIS 7 - SITZ 12A"}. She stands upright and solemn, framed by the wet station platform beyond.
Visible signage and text: Include exactly 1 main café sign reading {argument name="café sign text" default="NACHTCAFÉ – LETZTER ZUG"}. blocks.title: No. 79: 漫画 / 故事板 - Mid-Century City Travel Picture Book
blocks.description: A sophisticated prompt for generating charming vertical city illustrations inspired by 1950s-60s European travel books, featuring hand-drawn textures and simplified silhouettes.
blocks.prompt:
[DESTINATION] = {argument name="destination" default="[CITY NAME]"}
Create a charming vertical 4:5 mid-century travel picture-book illustration of [DESTINATION], inspired by playful 1950s–60s European city books.
Depict the city as an affectionate, imperfect travel memory—not a map, postcard, architectural rendering, landmark collage, or cinematic panorama.
Include:
• 1 distinctive primary landmark
• 1 smaller secondary landmark
• 1 distant/partially hidden local feature
• 1 recognizable local vehicle
• 3–5 subtle everyday city details
• 5–6 ordinary people doing simple local activities
Compress these naturally into one imaginary street, plaza, park, or waterfront. Keep the primary landmark slightly off-center, with open foreground, shallow theatrical depth, gentle curves, and generous museum-white negative space. The city should be recognizable without feeling geographically accurate.
STYLE:
Hand-drawn picture-book illustration with loose charcoal/navy ink, trembling contours, crooked architecture, uneven proportions, sparse windows, simplified silhouettes, occasional double strokes, and minimal detail. Use the fewest lines necessary. Slightly awkward, intelligent, warm, humorous, and handmade.
PEOPLE:
Simple expressive figures with oversized heads, thin legs, narrow bodies, tiny faces, tilted accessories, and awkward but readable gestures. Show ordinary local life, not celebrities, models, stereotypes, or tourist clichés.
COLOR:
Use a restrained 6–7 color destination-specific palette with flat matte gouache shapes, uneven brush edges, white gaps, slight misregistration, and occasional color spilling beyond ink. Mostly unpainted sky/paper. No gradients or realistic shading.
MEMORY DISTORTION:
Gently compress geography and distort scale: distant landmarks may appear nearby, roads may curve strangely, buildings may overlap, and people/vehicles may be slightly oversized or undersized. Keep it balanced, affectionate, and culturally respectful.
OPTIONAL TEXT:
“[DESTINATION]” in small uneven hand-drawn capitals near the bottom. No slogans, dates, labels, logos, or promotional text.
AVOID:
Photorealism, map-like accuracy, landmark checklists, aerial views, cinematic lighting, technical perspective, dense crowds, detailed ornament, polished vector art, CGI, 3D rendering, gradients, sepia/beige paper, artificial aging, distressed textures, and hyper-detailed watercolor.
Overall feeling: [DESTINATION] remembered lovingly-recognizable, spacious, human, humorous, slightly improbable, and beautifully imperfect.
blocks.author: Saul Goodman

blocks.title: No. 88: 产品营销 - Thermal Receipt Table Lamp Poster
blocks.description: A hot-pink editorial poster design that uses oversized cropped typography and a thermal receipt layout to advertise a playful flower-shaped table lamp.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold experimental product poster for a design-object announcement, combining an extreme cropped typography background with a thermal receipt layout overlay.
Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, off-white outer margin around a saturated hot-pink rectangular field. Use a clean print-design composition with slight risograph/thermal-paper grain and subtly imperfect ink edges.
Layout: Place one huge cream-white uppercase background title reading {argument name="product name" default="TABLE LAMP"}, spanning nearly the full width across the upper third; crop the letters heavily at the left and right edges so the title feels oversized and partially hidden. Center-right, overlay exactly one tall narrow cream thermal receipt running from near the top to near the bottom, with zigzag torn edges at the top and bottom. Add one thin vertical microtext line beside the receipt, rotated 90 degrees, reading like an archive/design ID. Along the bottom of the pink field place exactly two separate cream barcode blocks, one at bottom left and one at bottom right. The receipt itself contains exactly one black barcode near its bottom.
Receipt details: The receipt header has a large condensed black title {argument name="receipt header" default="TABLE LAMP"}. Under it, include the subtitle “AESTHETICS, SWITCHED ON”. Fill the receipt with monospaced thermal-printer text, dashed divider lines, and pseudo-transaction metadata. Include design-spec lines such as design registration number, date, time, terminal, transaction, attendant, product, object type, form study, material study, surface finish, light quality, curve ratio, form revision, assembly check, aesthetic value, archive index, subtotal, tax, payment method, authorization, thank-you note, return policy, and “KEEP THIS LIGHT RECEIPT”. Highlight exactly one line in a translucent pink marker strip: “GRAND TOTAL--BEAUTY, SWITCHED ON”.
Subject image on receipt: At the lower half of the receipt, print exactly one cute glossy flower-shaped table lamp illustration with a pink fluted pedestal stem, six rounded pink petals, a blue inner glow, a small orange-red circular center, and a thin pale power cord trailing left. Keep it centered above the receipt barcode.
Typography and style: Use condensed bold sans-serif for the massive background title, monospaced receipt type for all receipt text, black ink on warm cream paper, and a fashionable editorial graphic-design aesthetic. Main colors are {argument name="background color" default="hot pink"}, cream white, black, soft pink, blue, and orange-red. The image should feel like a modern poster generated from the structural idea of a thermal-paper receipt, not a realistic store receipt photo.
Constraints: Use exactly 3 visible barcodes total: 2 large background barcode blocks and 1 receipt barcode. Use exactly 1 receipt, exactly 1 product illustration, and exactly 1 highlighted grand-total line. Do not add people, logos, watermarks, QR codes, extra products, or extra receipts.

blocks.prompt: Create an ultra-premium street basketball sneaker advertising poster for an original brand called VANTAGE X, designed as a Cannes-level key visual that fuses luxury product photography, aggressive black-ink sports illustration, and explosive urban editorial typography. Preserve the exact core structure and camera logic of the image: one monumental hyper-real high-top basketball sneaker dominates the lower foreground in an extreme low-angle perspective, while a giant hand-drawn basketball player erupts across the upper background in a violent forward-driving action pose. The final image must now combine stronger Orbit impact, tighter Transit system control, and bolder Port-level concept integration, so the shoe feels like the source of all motion, power, and graphic force in the poster. Core composition: Use a tall vertical poster with one oversized sneaker in the lower-left to lower-center foreground, pushed slightly closer to the viewer for greater visual pressure. The toe box, side emblem, collar, laces, and outsole must feel monumental and tactile, as if the shoe is stepping directly into the viewer’s space. Behind and above it, place one huge black-ink sketch basketball player in an extreme explosive drive, jump, or pre-dunk attack moment, twisting through the frame with sharp momentum. Add one smaller secondary sketched player in the mid-background for layered court rhythm. The shoe must be the first thing seen; the illustrated players act as amplified motion ghosts generated by the shoe’s energy. Orbit impact enhancement: Increase the visual aggression of the foreground shoe. Make the sole impact at the base feel like it detonates the composition through bold black brush bursts, ink spray, fractured motion streaks, and launch-like ground energy. Tighten the distance between camera and shoe so the product feels heavier, closer, and more dominant. The poster must hit instantly with a “one step breaks the frame” sensation. Transit system enhancement: Keep the same skeletal layout, but unify the entire visual language into a mature black-and-white street-illustration system with one controlled hero product color event. The background athlete linework, speed lines, sketch shading, annotation marks, headline typography, secondary text, and impact splashes must all follow one disciplined graphic grammar: consistent ink weight, consistent roughness, consistent motion direction, and coordinated negative-space balance. The whole piece must feel like an official international sports campaign poster, not a collage of separate ideas. Port concept enhancement: Push the concept so the athlete’s motion visibly originates from the sneaker. Let selected ink lines, force strokes, and motion arcs extend from the shoe edges, outsole, and side emblem into the illustrated player’s limbs and trajectory, creating a clear idea that the player’s explosive action is being driven by the sneaker itself. The giant player can be captured in a more extreme airborne breakthrough or pre-slam moment, with the action lines visually tethered back to the shoe. The concept must feel bold and intelligent, not gimmicky. Product design: Design the shoe as a premium globally market-ready high-top street basketball sneaker from VANTAGE X. Use a bold colorway of metallic bronze-gold, matte black, off-white, and subtle silver technical accents. The upper should combine structured leather, engineered support panels, padded ankle protection, reinforced lace wings, sculpted heel geometry, and performance-driven outsole logic. Add an original VANTAGE X emblem on the lateral side. The shoe must feel elite, urban, muscular, and collectible. Material realism: Render the sneaker with exceptional realism and sharp commercial detail. The bronze-gold leather must feel smooth, rich, and premium with controlled highlights. Black areas must feel deep and performance-oriented with distinct texture separation. Show crisp stitching, lace weave, rubber density, sole grip, collar padding, and precise panel edges. The product must feel expensive, durable, and technically believable. Illustration style: Render the players and court world in expressive black ink sketch style with editorial sports aggression: raw contour lines, scratch shading, manga-like force marks, speed streaks, splatter accents, rough court geometry, and brush-impact sweeps. The drawn world should remain powerful but clearly secondary to the shoe. Keep the illustration highly art-directed, not messy. Typography and copy: Add fully original English typography integrated into the composition. Use one powerful headline such as “OWN THE ASPHALT” or “RISE ABOVE IMPACT,” rendered in a sharp custom street-sport editorial style. Add a refined support line such as “Engineered for explosive lift, locked grip, and court-born dominance.” Include a small premium VANTAGE X brand mark. Typography must feel dynamic, urban, aggressive, and compositionally precise. No copied wording, no generic font block. Background and environment: Keep the environment mostly white and minimal, constructed from perspective court lines, urban fragments, black ink slashes, motion scratches, and negative space. Use explosive black brushwork near the shoe base to anchor the product and visually launch the athlete upward. The environment must feel graphic and fast, never cluttered. Lighting: Use premium studio lighting on the sneaker, with soft directional highlights from upper-left and front-left, giving the metallic bronze-gold surfaces a luxurious glow. The illustration can remain flatter and more graphic, but should align with the shoe’s motion and shadow logic. The contrast between hyper-real product lighting and raw ink energy is essential. Color direction: Keep the overall palette tightly controlled: white field, black illustration system, bronze-gold hero product surfaces, black technical components, off-white sole accents, and minimal silver highlights. The shoe must remain the dominant color event in the frame. Mood: explosive, urban, dominant, athletic, rebellious, premium, graphic, collectible, aggressive, editorial, high-performance, street-basketball energy. Rendering style: ultra-premium sneaker campaign poster, oversized hyper-real basketball shoe, extreme low-angle perspective, giant black-ink sketch athlete, unified street illustration system, motion lines extending from shoe into athlete action, luxury material realism, dynamic editorial typography, 8k, world-class advertising image quality. Negative prompt: copied logos, copied slogans, generic shoe design, weak foreground shoe, cluttered background, soft blurry sneaker, cheap comic style, flat materials, plastic-looking bronze panels, messy typography, low-resolution sketch lines, weak motion, generic sports ad, over-rendered city background

blocks.prompt: A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of translucent snow pear from a stewing pot, with clear syrup forming a small backflow along the tip of the spoon. Design a 3:4 vertical rock sugar stewed pear poster for an original nourishing dessert brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}". The scene is set exclusively on a warm white stone window sill on an autumn morning. A 15cm diameter transparent heat-resistant glass stewing pot is placed slightly to the right of the center, with the glass lid lying flat to the back left. The pot is 70% full of clear light-gold syrup, precisely containing eight pieces of cut snow pear, six pieces of transparent rock sugar, and three dried osmanthus flowers. A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of pear from the right, stopping about 4cm above the rim of the pot, with the syrup backflow controlled at 3cm. The center of the pot is at 62% horizontal and 64% vertical, occupying about 38% of the frame width. The area from 7% to 42% horizontal and 9% to 47% vertical on the left remains a warm white text zone. The foreground contains only half a fresh snow pear with the cut side facing up, while the background features a soft white sheer curtain; do not add red dates, wolfberries, or tremella. The camera is 12cm above the middle of the pot, using a 90mm macro lens shooting from the front left at a 14-degree angle from a distance of 72cm. The focus is locked on the pear fibers in the spoon, the transparency of the syrup, and the edge of the glass pot, with the lid remaining recognizable. A large window-shaped soft light of about 5500K from the back left penetrates the syrup and pear meat, while a warm white reflector at the front right restores the glass contours. Two strands of very faint steam rise towards the window. The color scheme is 52% warm white background, 18% transparent light-gold syrup, 20% pear milk white, 5% glass gray, and 5% dark brown text. Pear meat should be soft and slightly translucent but retain its chunk shape; syrup should be clear and low-viscosity, not a thick jam or milky soup. Text is limited to brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}", product name "{argument name="product name" default="Rock Sugar Stewed Pear"}", main copy "{argument name="main copy" default="Pear fragrance stewed slowly, sweetness falls clearly"}", and English sub-title "ROCK SUGAR STEWED PEAR". The main text on the left uses a dark brown fine Song font in three lines, brand name at the top, product name and English at bottom left. Lock one pot, one lid, eight pear chunks, six rock sugar pieces, three osmanthus flowers, one glass spoon, and back-left window light; do not add herbs, a second pot, excessive condensation, thick steam, or floating pear chunks.
blocks.author: Mr.pinecone

blocks.title: No. 95: 电商主图 - Mesh Top and Checkered Skirt Outfit
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion generation prompt for a classical girlie look, detailing the fabric textures, seams, and construction of a mesh knit crop top and a checkered A-line mini skirt.
blocks.prompt: Wardrobe: Top: One solid muted cocoa-taupe sleeveless mock-neck crop top made from a fine-gauge stretch mesh knit with tightly regular micro-openings, a lightweight semi-sheer section, a smooth low-luster face, soft close drape, and resilient multidirectional recovery. Cut a close straight-to-lightly-tapered body ending at the upper waist, with matching front and rear lower-edge levels and minimal bulk. Form a narrow circular self-fabric mock neck whose finished height is between one-tenth and one-sixth of the shoulder-to-hem length, using a double-layer return and one low-bulk rear join. Continue two narrow shoulder sections into high-cut sleeveless armholes and uninterrupted front and rear body panels. Finish both armhole circuits with narrow self-fabric turned bindings less than one-tenth of the shoulder-section width, join the body through two clean side seams, and complete the lower circumference with one narrow straight double-turn hem. Use the knit recovery and complete neck opening for a pull-on construction without exterior fastening. Keep the mesh scale evenly legible, the semi-sheer density consistent, the mock neck softly upright, the armhole edges flat, and the lower hem free of heavy opaque bulk. Bottom: One camel-tan wrap-front mini skirt made from medium-weight brushed twill with a compact diagonal weave, a short soft nap, a matte low-luster surface, firm shape retention, and rounded low-bulk folds; confine espresso brown, ivory, and muted dusty-rose to the woven geometric check and matte black to two front buttons. Cut a high-rise upper-thigh mini length with a close waist and upper hip, then widen gently into a compact A-line hem whose laid-flat width is between one-and-one-fifth and one-and-two-fifths of the top-edge width. Form a clean curved faced upper edge without a separate exterior waistband. Build smooth front and rear bodies with two equal rear waist darts, one at product-right and one at product-left, two side seams, and one full-height product-left front overlap panel spanning between one-half and two-thirds of the front width; keep its vertical free edge straight from the top edge to the hem and its underlap continuous behind it. Cover every front, overlap, side, and rear panel with a woven repeat of large upright camel rectangles bounded by single espresso lines and paired ivory lines, then add one fine dusty-rose pinstripe only to alternating vertical and horizontal corridors so the rose intersections shift by one cell on every second row; each complete repeat spans between one-quarter and one-third of the laid-flat front width, with straight orthogonal lines and clean registration across darts, seams, and the overlap. Mount two circular matte-black four-hole buttons in one vertical product-left-front line, each between one-tenth and one-eighth of the waist-to-hem depth in diameter; place the upper station within the upper quarter of that depth and the lower station between one-half and two-thirds of the depth. Secure the overlap through two matching reinforced buttonholes on the underlap, keeping both stations fully engaged and the panel flat, and finish the complete lower edge with one narrow turned hem. Preserve the short brushed nap, readable diagonal weave, crisp A-line outline, stable overlap depth, aligned geometric repeat, flat button seating, and material-correct hem thickness. Footwear: One matching pair of predominantly black combat boots built from medium-thick semi-matte coated leather-like upper material with a fine shallow grain and broad flexible crease response, black flat woven cord, silver-tone metal, and deep black molded rubber. Each boot is knee-high with a tall straight shaft, a broad rounded toe, a substantial forefoot platform, and a slightly deeper rear block, with shaft volume remaining open and stable near the top before compressing into broad slouch folds through the lower shaft and ankle. A wide straight topline forms the shaft opening and retains a clean finished edge. The upper consists of tall side and rear shaft panels joined to a rounded forefoot, broad vamp, quarters, and a central tongue; the vamp stays close while the shaft carries relaxed vertical volume. Paired rows of black lace holes run from the forefoot into the lower shaft and hold flat black laces, while two separate narrow wrap straps encircle each boot, one near the upper shaft and one at the ankle, each ending at its own compact rectangular silver-tone buckle. Tonal topstitching defines the panel joins, and the sole forms a thick continuous sidewall above a deeply cut lugged contact face. The laces close in compact tied bows and both buckle straps remain fastened through their rectangular frames. Both boots are identical anatomical mirror counterparts with the same panel layout, lace path, strap count, buckle placement, shaft height, slouch distribution, toe shape, and sole stack. Preserve the coated fine grain through the broad folds, keep the two buckle circuits physically separate from the lace closure, and maintain crisp sole edges, deep lug relief, firm toe volume, and material-correct seam bulk. Bag: Styling — highest priority: - Bag carry: Hang the strap from the wearer-right shoulder only without crossing the chest, and let the bag body lie flat along the right flank between the lower ribs and outer hip. Let the strap bear the full weight and keep both hands off the bag and strap. Keep the complete strap and bag body entirely outside and visibly separate from every garment, routing the strap over, never beneath or through, the outermost clothing. Do not pass it through any neckline, sleeve, knit opening, seam, or rear panel, and do not merge, attach, weave, replace, or reinterpret any bag material as part of a garment. - Finish — Natural: Adjust only material-correct slack and body contact along the exact selected strap route. Keep the selected route and all attachment points exact while allowing limited material-correct slack and natural body contact. One warm-ivory soft gathered chain-strap pouch bag made from lightweight lightly padded matte woven fabric, constructed as one medium rounded crescent-like body with softly tapered upper corners, a broad curved lower edge, shallow expandable side depth, and controlled flexible volume. Gather the complete upper body into one reinforced top-edge opening, producing repeated soft vertical folds that release through the front, rear, and side surfaces without rigid quilting lines. Add one long warm-gold-tone curb-chain strap attached through two small polished gold-tone D-rings and reinforced matching fabric tabs at the upper sides, preserving identical attachment height and hardware construction on both ends. Complete the front, rear, side panels, curved base, gathered upper edge, reinforced top opening, chain strap, D-rings, attachment tabs, hidden seam allowances, and internal soft support as one coherent bag with no visible exterior closure hardware, exterior pocket, readable branding, detachable charm, keychain, plush ornament, mascot, or additional decoration. Preserve lightweight textile response, softly padded body volume, even gather distribution, clean upper-edge reinforcement, secure chain anchoring, low seam bulk, and restrained warm-gold reflections. Necklace: One short silver fine-chain necklace built as one continuous closed circuit with a shallow curved ornament centered on one product axis. Keep most of the circuit as a slender uniform chain and confine the ornament to a short lower arc substantially shorter than the complete chain path. Construct the ornament from a closely spaced row of uniform short rounded cylindrical beads aligned radially to form a gentle crescent, connecting both ornament terminals directly into compact polished chain links. Maintain bilateral orn

blocks.title: No. 96: 电商主图 - Professional Cosmetic Beauty Collage
blocks.description: Generates a multi-panel beauty editorial collage focusing on detailed facial features, eyes, and skin textures for a cosmetic campaign look.
blocks.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic beauty photography collage featuring a {argument name="subject" default="young woman with warm fair skin, soft brown eyes, naturally shaped eyebrows, long dark-brown hair with wispy bangs, and soft natural pink lips"}. Create a clean four-panel composition with multiple close-up angles of her eyes and face, including an extreme eye close-up, a 3/4 facial portrait, and detailed eye-and-brow shots. Emphasize realistic eyelashes, natural skin texture, subtle pores, soft peachy makeup, glossy eyes with realistic catchlights, delicate facial features, and finely detailed hair strands. Use {argument name="lighting" default="warm soft studio lighting"}, gentle shadows, {argument name="color tones" default="creamy neutral tones"}, shallow depth of field, premium beauty-editorial photography, ultra-sharp details, photorealistic skin, high dynamic range, professional cosmetic campaign aesthetic, 8K quality. Keep the composition minimal, elegant, clean, and highly realistic with thin white borders separating each panel.

blocks.title: No. 99: 电商主图 - Pinstriped Button-Up Shirt Design
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion prompt detailing the construction, styling, and embroidery of a cropped pinstriped shirt with rolled sleeves and botanical threadwork.
blocks.prompt: ワードローブ： トップス： スタイリング： - フロントクロージャー：フロント中央のクロージャーの上部約3分の1だけを開け、胸より下のクロージャーはすべて裾まで留めたままにする。上部の開口部は左右対称に保つ。開口部を下部まで広げたり、上部を閉じ直したりしない。 - 袖：各袖口を外側にちょうど2回折り返し、両腕にダブルロールのバンドを作る。両方のバンドを前腕の中ほど、肘の折り目より下で手首より上の位置に配置する。他のスタイリング指示で衣服が肩から下がった場合でも、この巻き数と高さを維持する。袖を肘まで押し上げたり、袖口を隠したりしない。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル： - フロントクロージャー：選択した上部開口部のみを外し、下の留め具はすべて留めたままにする。その間隔を変更せず、固定された留め状態に隣接するパネルのドレープのみを調整する。 - 袖：選択した数、位置、向き、レイヤー順序を変更しない。固定された袖の高さより下のロール構造のみを調整し、元の袖口を保持する。適度な重なりとわずかな非対称性を持つ柔らかい折り目を使用する。 淡いスカイブルーと白の垂直ピンストライプの長袖クロップドボタンアップシャツ。軽量なポプリン風の織物で、パリッとしたマットな質感。ボクシーなシルエットで、ウエストより上で終わる裾を持つ。白いポインテッドカラーと、小さな白いボタンが並ぶフロント前立てを備える。袖山に軽いギャザーがあり、広いピンストライプのバレルカフスはボタンで閉じられている。左胸にパッチポケットがあり、全体に白い植物風の刺繍やオープンワークが施されている。左胸ポケットには、半透明の花びらのアップリケやビーズを用いた立体的な装飾が集中している。ジッパーや余計な装飾のない、一貫したデザインのシャツである。 ボトムス：淡いクールグレーのハイライズフレアミニスカート。中重量のコンパクトなポンチニット製で、マットな質感。太もも上部丈のスケーターシルエット。伸縮性のあるアッパーバンドを備え、複数のパネルとシームラインで構成されている。ポケットやジッパーのないプルオンタイプで、素材の厚みと放射状のフレアを維持している。 レッグウェア：温かみのある白のショートクルーソックス。上質な垂直リブニット製で、左右対称の設計。リブ編みのアッパーカフと補強されたかかと・つま先を持ち、装飾のないシンプルなデザイン。適度な不透明度とストレッチ性を備えている。 フットウェア：温かみのあるアイボリーのロートップチャンキーレザースニーカー。丸いつま先と厚いプラットフォームソールが特徴。アッパーはスエード調の素材とオフホワイトのメッシュを組み合わせ、幾何学的なオーバーレイを配置。オフホワイトの靴紐が左右対称に通されている。頑丈なラグトレッドを備えた厚底ソールを持ち、細部まで一貫した配色と質感で仕上げられている。 バッグ： スタイリング： - バッグの持ち方：ストラップを左肩からのみ下げ、バッグ本体を左脇腹に置く。胸を横切らせず、手は添えない。バッグとストラップは衣服の外側に完全に露出させ、衣服の下や中を通さないこと。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル：選択したストラップのルートに沿って、素材に忠実な緩みと体への接触のみを調整する。選択したルートとすべての取り付けを維持する。

blocks.description: A highly technical fashion prompt detailing the construction, styling, and embroidery of a cropped pinstriped shirt with rolled sleeves and botanical threadwork.
blocks.prompt: ワードローブ： トップス： スタイリング： - フロントクロージャー：フロント中央のクロージャーの上部約3分の1だけを開け、胸より下のクロージャーはすべて裾まで留めたままにする。上部の開口部は左右対称に保つ。開口部を下部まで広げたり、上部を閉じ直したりしない。 - 袖：各袖口を外側にちょうど2回折り返し、両腕にダブルロールのバンドを作る。両方のバンドを前腕の中ほど、肘の折り目より下で手首より上の位置に配置する。他のスタイリング指示で衣服が肩から下がった場合でも、この巻き数と高さを維持する。袖を肘まで押し上げたり、袖口を隠したりしない。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル： - フロントクロージャー：選択した上部開口部のみを外し、下の留め具はすべて留めたままにする。その間隔を変更せず、固定された留め状態に隣接するパネルのドレープのみを調整する。 - 袖：選択した数、位置、向き、レイヤー順序を変更しない。固定された袖の高さより下のロール構造のみを調整し、元の袖口を保持する。適度な重なりとわずかな非対称性を持つ柔らかい折り目を使用する。 淡いスカイブルーと白の垂直ピンストライプの長袖クロップドボタンアップシャツ。軽量なポプリン風の織物で、パリッとしたマットな質感。ボクシーなシルエットで、ウエストより上で終わる裾を持つ。白いポインテッドカラーと、小さな白いボタンが並ぶフロント前立てを備える。袖山に軽いギャザーがあり、広いピンストライプのバレルカフスはボタンで閉じられている。左胸にパッチポケットがあり、全体に白い植物風の刺繍やオープンワークが施されている。左胸ポケットには、半透明の花びらのアップリケやビーズを用いた立体的な装飾が集中している。ジッパーや余計な装飾のない、一貫したデザインのシャツである。 ボトムス：淡いクールグレーのハイライズフレアミニスカート。中重量のコンパクトなポンチニット製で、マットな質感。太もも上部丈のスケーターシルエット。伸縮性のあるアッパーバンドを備え、複数のパネルとシームラインで構成されている。ポケットやジッパーのないプルオンタイプで、素材の厚みと放射状のフレアを維持している。 レッグウェア：温かみのある白のショートクルーソックス。上質な垂直リブニット製で、左右対称の設計。リブ編みのアッパーカフと補強されたかかと・つま先を持ち、装飾のないシンプルなデザイン。適度な不透明度とストレッチ性を備えている。 フットウェア：温かみのあるアイボリーのロートップチャンキーレザースニーカー。丸いつま先と厚いプラットフォームソールが特徴。アッパーはスエード調の素材とオフホワイトのメッシュを組み合わせ、幾何学的なオーバーレイを配置。オフホワイトの靴紐が左右対称に通されている。頑丈なラグトレッドを備えた厚底ソールを持ち、細部まで一貫した配色と質感で仕上げられている。 バッグ： スタイリング： - バッグの持ち方：ストラップを左肩からのみ下げ、バッグ本体を左脇腹に置く。胸を横切らせず、手は添えない。バッグとストラップは衣服の外側に完全に露出させ、衣服の下や中を通さないこと。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル：選択したストラップのルートに沿って、素材に忠実な緩みと体への接触のみを調整する。選択したルートとすべての取り付けを維持する。

blocks.title: No. 101: 电商主图 - Cinematic Pepsi Energy Drink Video Sequence
blocks.description: A complex cinematic commercial prompt for a Pepsi energy drink featuring detailed liquid physics and product interaction, intended for video generation.
blocks.prompt: Cinematic Pepsi energy drink commercial, ultra-realistic product photography style. A sleek blue and silver Pepsi can standing upright on a reflective dark surface with a soft gradient grey background. Condensation water droplets cover the can. A strong male hand reaches in and pulls the ice-cold Pepsi can out of a metal ice bucket filled with clear ice cubes. Extreme close-up of water droplets on the metallic surface of the can. The pull-tab opens with a burst of cold mist and vapor rising from the top. Golden amber liquid pours from the can into a clear glass filled with ice cubes, creating bubbles and fizz. A shirtless, extremely muscular, fit young man with sharp jawline and short brown hair drinks from the Red Bull can, eyes closed in satisfaction, then smiles confidently while holding the can. Dynamic action shot of the Red Bull can floating in mid-air surrounded by exploding ice cubes, water splash, and light rays. Final shot: Pepsi logo (two red Pepsi and yellow sun) appears above the cold, wet Pepsi can on a reflective surface. High-end commercial lighting, sharp details, cold blue and silver color grading, steam and condensation effects, 8K, photorealistic.

blocks.title: No. 102: 电商主图 - Realistic Indoor Fashion Portrait

The model has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long layered wavy hair with airy bangs, natural makeup, smooth skin, visible subtle collarbone detail, a small delicate necklace, a thin bracelet, and a ring. Outfit: a fitted ribbed knit sleeveless V-neck camisole in {argument name="top color" default="warm taupe brown"} with a pointed hem, paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers in {argument name="pants color" default="cream white"}. blocks.title: No. 108: 电商主图 - 禅意乌龙茶电商详情页
blocks.description: 一份精心设计的提示词，旨在为概念茶品牌生成高端移动端优先的电商详情页，遵循具有禅意美学的结构化客户转化路径。
blocks.prompt:
为概念品牌“{argument name="brand name" default="LANXU"}”设计一个高端移动端优先的电商详情页，针对“{argument name="product name" default="高山乌龙茶"}”打造完整的转化路径。该产品为两罐装礼盒，每罐净含量为“{argument name="net content" default="100g"}”。
严格保持一致性：品牌“LANXU”，两罐圆柱形金属茶罐（高约 135mm，直径 78mm），采用岩灰色哑光饰面，配以古铜色盖子。垂直品牌标识“LANXU”和产品标签在两个罐子上必须完全一致。视觉系统：“禅意奢华 + 自然有机”，核心概念“杯中云雾”。配色方案：岩灰、雾白、芽绿、琥珀茶色和氧化铜色。图形语言：抽象的山谷轮廓、稀薄的晨雾和扩散的茶汤层次。排版：现代宋体搭配简洁的无衬线字体，留白充裕。
布局：宽度约 1242px，垂直长图（比例 1:5）。包含七个连续模块：
1. “核心价值”：两罐茶叶与礼盒置于抽象的云雾山谷背景中，标题为“杯中云雾”。
2. “饮用价值”：干茶、叶底和清澈琥珀茶汤的微距摄影，标注“风味特征：以实际测评为准”。
3. “产地与原料”：抽象的茶园坡地与采摘细节，预留产地和海拔信息位置。
4. “制作工艺”：四个步骤（采摘、萎凋、烘焙、包装），预留工艺名称位置。
5. “冲泡体验”：白瓷盖碗、公道杯和注茶的写实场景；预留温度和时间信息位置。
6. “包装与规格”：清晰展示礼盒、两罐茶叶、开启状态及“100g x 2 罐”标签。
7. “购买信任”：礼赠场景、规格占位符及物流信息。
风格：结合真实商业摄影与精致平面设计的高端电商艺术指导。所有物品必须具备真实的比例和接触点。茶叶不得悬浮，雾气不得遮挡产品可见度。
仅展示核心文本：“LANXU”、“高山乌龙”、“杯中云雾”、“原叶形态”、“风味特征：占位符”、“产地信息：占位符”、“工艺信息：占位符”、“冲泡建议：占位符”、“100g x 2 罐”、“产品信息：占位符”。
blocks.author: Mr.pinecone

blocks.title: No. 109: 电商主图 - 极简抽象茶叶包装视觉设计
blocks.description: 生成极简且抽象的茶叶包装概念，运用地形纹理与特定材质质感，打造高端品牌形象。
blocks.prompt: 为包装设计方案构思一套茶叶包装主视觉，核心概念为“山雾将一口茶折叠进纸盒中的微缩地形”。产品为 {argument name="product series" default="三款不同发酵程度的高山乌龙系列"}。画面展示了三组细长的抽屉式礼盒与小罐，陈列在如同岩层切面的灰白色基座上。包装图案并非传统的山水插画，而是由茶汤色泽、海拔等高线与雾气层叠组成的抽象地形系统。构图采用横向展示摄影，前、中、后景层次分明。主包装盒正对镜头，侧边盒与小罐形成结构上的错落变化。背景保留大面积低对比度的留白，适合包装提案展示。光线采用柔和的侧向晨雾光，不追求高对比度，而是着重表现纸张压纹、局部烫银、封口贴、锡箔内袋以及茶叶干叶的质感。{argument name="color scheme" default="配色方案根据系列分为冷雾灰绿、焙火褐灰与浅金琥珀色"}，整体色调需保持低饱和度、克制且成熟。材质重点描述特种纸纤维、压印等高线、局部 UV、封口铝膜、茶罐拉丝金属盖以及茶叶叶脉。画面需包含少量中文为主的文字，包括系列中文名称、单品名称、极简的英文辅助标识以及角落的海拔批次信息。文字应直接融入包装正面的设计系统中。

blocks.title: No. 117: 游戏素材 - Console Generations Rooftop Game Collage
blocks.description: Generates a four-panel retro game comparison screenshot showing one rooftop stage across 8-bit, 16-bit, PS1, and PS2-inspired styles.
blocks.prompt:
Create a 16:9 promotional screenshot collage for a retro puzzle-action game called {argument name="game title" default="ConsoleChaos"}, showing the same side-scrolling rooftop stage rendered in four different console-generation styles at once. Divide the canvas into an exact 2x2 grid with thin black borders between panels, like a technical pilot comparison screen. Use strong CRT scanlines across the entire image, low-resolution pixel-art aesthetics, slightly blurry capture artifacts, and dark cyberpunk city colors.
Top-left panel: 8-bit / Famicom-style side-view platformer. Magenta-purple night sky, flat pixelated buildings, yellow-green tiled ground, three simple brown vertical towers with small pale windows. A tiny pink-haired anime girl sprite in white/pink is mid-jump moving right. Very limited palette, chunky pixels, high contrast.
Top-right panel: 16-bit / Super Famicom-style side-view platformer. Bright blue sky with long flat white clouds, green rooftop fence/platform, blue building facade with rows of yellow-lit windows. The same pink-haired anime girl sprite stands on the platform facing right, wearing a blue outfit. Cleaner sprites and more colors than the top-left panel.
Bottom-left panel: early PlayStation-style 3D view. Third-person camera behind and slightly to the side of a low-poly pink-haired anime girl character standing on a gray tiled rooftop. Purple foggy night skyline, blocky buildings with a few lit windows, visible polygon edges and jagged texture warping. Add a black UI strip along the bottom with tiny white Japanese debug-like text and button hints.
Bottom-right panel: PlayStation 2-style 3D view. Third-person 3D rooftop scene at night with a larger, smoother anime girl character facing the camera, pink twin-tail hair, dark blue/black outfit with blue skirt and boots. She stands on a broad gray tiled rooftop with city buildings and yellow-lit windows below, a raised platform and blocky obstacle behind her, plus a small red object on the platform. Dark navy sky, more detailed geometry than bottom-left but still retro game-like. Include faint tiny white UI/debug text near the lower left edge.
Character details: use one recurring heroine, {argument name="character name" default="pink-haired anime girl"}, with pastel pink hair and a blue/black futuristic school-uniform-inspired outfit in the later-generation panels. Keep the four render styles clearly distinct: 8-bit, 16-bit, PS1 low-poly, and PS2-era 3D. blocks.description: A square 3x3 preview sheet of nine pastel chibi LINE stickers featuring a fox-eared anime girl and penguin companion with Japanese captions.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute completed LINE sticker sheet featuring {argument name="character name" default="a small white-haired fox-eared anime girl"} and {argument name="animal companion" default="a round navy-blue penguin chick"} in a soft kawaii chibi style.
Canvas: Square image, white background, arranged as a clean 3 by 3 grid of exactly 9 separate sticker illustrations with generous spacing. Each sticker has no border and appears like a transparent-background LINE stamp preview placed on white.
Visual style: Pastel anime chibi illustration, soft watercolor-like shading, rounded forms, expressive faces, tiny hands and feet, sparkles and small motion marks. The girl has long fluffy white hair with pale pink tips, fox/cat ears, a big fluffy pink-white tail, blue eyes, and an oversized dark blue hoodie with pale yellow shoes. The penguin is short and plush-like with a dark navy body, white face/belly, tiny orange beak and feet, and a shy adorable expression. Use thick-but-soft sticker outlines and lively handwritten Japanese captions in bright pastel colors.
Text content: Include exactly 9 Japanese sticker captions, one per sticker, matching this set: {argument name="sticker captions" default="おはよ〜 / ありがとっ！ / おつかれさま〜 / OKだよ〜 / ごめん〜 / いってら〜！ / よろしくね。 / おやすみ〜 / またね！"}. Render the captions as playful handwritten text above or near each character, using orange, yellow, blue, green, pink, or red depending on the sticker mood.
Sticker layout and count: Exactly 9 stickers in 3 rows and 3 columns:
1. Top left, caption “おはよ〜”: the girl smiles and waves energetically beside the penguin; cheerful morning mood with yellow/orange text and small sparkles.
2. Top center, caption “ありがとっ！”: the girl bows politely with hands together or sleeves forward; grateful expression, penguin nearby; orange text.
3. Top right, caption “おつかれさま〜”: the girl cuddles or leans close with the penguin, relaxed and appreciative; light blue text and sparkles.
4. Middle left, caption “OKだよ〜”: the girl makes an OK gesture or confident pose next to the penguin; green text with sparkles.
5. Middle center, caption “ごめん〜”: the girl looks apologetic and sad with droopy posture; penguin also subdued; blue text.
6. Middle right, caption “いってら〜！”: the girl and penguin move energetically as if sending someone off; red text and motion emphasis.
7. Bottom left, caption “よろしくね。”: the girl bows or clasps hands sweetly, polite introduction vibe; pink text.
8. Bottom center, caption “おやすみ〜”: the girl sleeps under a light blue blanket patterned with stars/clouds, penguin tucked beside her; purple/pink text.
9. Bottom right, caption “またね！”: the girl waves goodbye with one arm raised while the penguin stands beside her; orange text.
Constraints: Keep all 9 stickers clearly separated and fully visible, no extra stickers, no cropped characters, no watermark, no realistic rendering, no background scene beyond white space and small decorative sparkles. Make it look like a finished LINE sticker set preview generated as one square sheet.

He faces the camera directly with a calm, serious editorial expression, short neat black hair, clean-shaven face, relaxed posture, one hand in his pants pocket and the other resting naturally at his side. Dress him in an oversized brown-and-cream athletic streetwear jersey with a wide cream horizontal chest band, bold collegiate lettering reading {argument name="jersey text" default="STREWEAR"}, the number {argument name="jersey number" default="33"} on the chest, and matching numbers on both sleeves; pair it with loose black track pants with white drawstrings and thin white side stripes, plus clean white low-top sneakers. The studio should have a seamless warm tan wall and floor, tall sheer cream curtains on both left and right edges, and one potted palm plant in a terracotta pot at the lower left. Use golden-hour sunlight streaming from the side to cast long diagonal window shadows across the wall and floor, creating a soft luxury editorial mood without any visible brand logos. blocks.title: No. 31: 社交媒体帖子 - European Academic Editorial Portrait
blocks.description: A cinematic editorial portrait prompt featuring a woman in a university classroom, with detailed descriptions of European architecture, fashion, and natural window lighting.
blocks.prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph of a beautiful {argument name="nationality" default="young adult Portuguese"} woman in her early 20s inside a completely empty, elegant university classroom. The room features warm wooden desks and chairs arranged in neat rows, tall classic windows, a large chalkboard, subtle European academic architecture, and soft natural daylight filtering into the room.
She has naturally beautiful features, warm olive-toned skin, expressive hazel-brown eyes, and long chestnut-brown hair with soft waves, styled naturally with a few delicate strands framing her face. Her makeup is refined and minimal, emphasizing her natural beauty.
She wears a {argument name="outfit style" default="sophisticated yet attractive modern university outfit"}: a fitted ivory blouse with subtle textured details, a tailored deep-burgundy blazer worn open, a high-waisted dark pleated skirt falling below the knee, sheer black tights, and elegant leather loafers. The styling feels fashionable, feminine, confident, and effortlessly European without being overly revealing.
Pose her naturally beside a classroom desk, standing in a graceful three-quarter profile toward the camera. One hand rests lightly on the desk while the other gently adjusts her blazer sleeve. Her posture is relaxed and confident, with one foot slightly ahead of the other. She looks toward the camera with a subtle, natural smile and calm, self-assured expression.
Use {argument name="lighting" default="cinematic natural window lighting"} coming from the side, softly illuminating her face and hair while creating gentle shadows across the classroom. Warm highlights, realistic skin tones, subtle contrast, soft atmospheric depth, and a sophisticated European fashion-editorial mood.
Photographed with an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, precise focus on her eyes, realistic skin texture, individual hair strands, detailed fabric textures, natural proportions, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, cinematic color grading, and ultra-detailed 8K photorealism.
Composition: vertical 4:5 full-body fashion portrait, slightly low eye-level perspective, elegant framing with the classroom environment clearly visible in the background, natural negative space, premium magazine photography aesthetic.

blocks.description: A cinematic fantasy animal-warrior portrait featuring a smug armored hamster general on a sunset mountain cliff.
blocks.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic fantasy portrait of a proud anthropomorphic hamster warrior general standing on a rocky cliff at sunset. It stands upright in a heroic low-angle composition with both small arms crossed over its chest, looking slightly upward and to the right as if surveying a battlefield. The setting is an epic mountain overlook with rugged rocks in the foreground and distant hazy mountains. The sky is filled with dramatic orange-gold sunset clouds, with the sun low near the right horizon creating warm rim light around the hamster’s fur and armor. Use ultra-detailed CGI realism, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, warm color grading, heroic fantasy movie atmosphere, no text, no watermark. Optional subject customization: {argument name="animal warrior" default="anthropomorphic hamster warrior general"}, {argument name="armor style" default="ornate ancient bronze warlord armor"}, {argument name="cape color" default="dark crimson"}, {argument name="pose" default="arms crossed with a smug proud smile"}, {argument name="background" default="rocky mountain cliff at golden sunset"}.

blocks.title: No. 34: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Hot Air Balloon Vlog Storyboard
blocks.description: Generates a professional 6-scene cinematic storyboard infographic for a 30-second sunrise hot-air-balloon travel vlog.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, information-dense storyboard infographic for a travel vlog titled {argument name="headline text" default="30-SECOND ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC TRAVEL VLOG - STORYBOARD"}, showing a cinematic hot-air-balloon adventure at sunrise with one consistent female protagonist.
Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet on a white background with thin black/gray grid lines, like a professional production planning board. Use a bold centered all-caps headline across the top. Arrange the main content in exactly 6 numbered scene cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, with a lower technical notes strip spanning the full width.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic travel documentary stills, 4K HDR feel, golden sunrise light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, warm atmospheric haze, natural wind movement, professional camera quality. The setting is a beautiful hot-air-balloon launch site and aerial valley landscape with vineyards, winding rivers, mountains, villages, baskets, burner flames, and many colorful balloons.
Main character: Use one female protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="the same young woman throughout"}, with shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm medium skin tone, soft oval face, and a friendly smile. She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.
Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.
Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:
1. Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Notes: Scene/action: drone wide reveal of balloons at sunrise; cut to walking selfie as she approaches the launch field, smiling. Dialogue: {argument name="opening dialogue" default="Good morning! Today we're finally going on a hot air balloon adventure!"}
2. Preparing for Takeoff (4–8 sec): four thumbnails showing colorful balloon fabric inflating, realistic burner flames, the woman watching excitedly beside the balloon, and her near/inside the basket. Notes: crew inflates balloons, burner fires, she talks to pilot, watches balloon expand, and steps into the basket. Dialogue: “I can't believe how massive these balloons are up close!” Camera/movement: wide, close-up burner, gimbal follow, POV entering basket.
3. Lift-Off (8–13 sec): three thumbnails showing a close-up portrait of the woman, a side profile at the basket rail, and a wide aerial landscape with balloons floating. Notes: balloon lifts off, she records selfie and looks over edge as the landscape shrinks below. Dialogue: “We're actually floating... this is unbelievable!” Camera/movement: selfie, drone orbit, over-shoulder, wide aerial shot.
4. Floating Above the Valley (13–18 sec): three thumbnails showing a high aerial valley with river and balloons, a close portrait in the basket, and a POV view over vineyards and villages. Notes: golden sunlight over valley, rivers, vineyards, and hills; she admires the view and points at distant balloons. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Notes: she takes photos, waves to other ballooners, and enjoys peaceful mid-flight moments. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.
6. Landing & Farewell (24–30 sec): three thumbnails showing the balloon landing with crew silhouettes, a smiling farewell portrait, and a final aerial view of balloons in the sunrise haze. Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.
Bottom technical strip: Include exactly 5 labeled information boxes across the bottom plus a small centered character portrait near the identity box. The 5 boxes are: Camera & Cinematography, Audio, Environment, Character (Locked Identity), and Negative Prompt. Fill them with compact bullet-style text: Sony FX3, RED V-Raptor, DJI Ronin 4D, DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, 24mm/35mm/50mm/65mm lenses, handheld/gimbal/drone/POV/orbit, 4K HDR, shallow DOF, natural light; natural dialogue, wind, burner flames, birds, crew conversations, basket creaks, footsteps, soft cinematic orchestral music; sunrise hot-air balloon site, colorful balloons, wicker baskets, burners, valleys, rivers, vineyards, mountains, golden-hour light, realistic weather and atmosphere; use uploaded reference as single source, same face/hair/skin tone/makeup, ivory dress and beige cardigan, natural expressions only, no identity drift or wardrobe changes; no face distortion, no identity drift, no duplicate characters, no broken anatomy, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no flickering, no frame warping, no inconsistent wardrobe, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no timestamps, no UI overlays.
Constraints: The final image must read as a polished production storyboard, not a movie poster. Keep all 6 scene cards visible and numbered, keep the bottom 5 technical boxes, use consistent typography, preserve the same woman and outfit in every thumbnail, and avoid adding extra scenes or extra characters as protagonists.

blocks.title: No. 39: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - DNA Nucleotides 3D Infographic
blocks.description: A detailed 3D educational biology infographic showing a labeled DNA double helix with nucleotide base pairs, hydrogen bonds, backbone, and emerging RNA.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 3D scientific educational infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="DNA Nucleotides"}, showing a close-up view of a DNA double helix with labeled nucleotide bases and molecular structure.
Canvas: Landscape 4:3 composition, bright white laboratory-style background with soft depth-of-field molecular clusters in pale blue, lavender, mint, and purple around the edges. Use a clean, high-resolution textbook/medical visualization style with realistic glossy translucent spheres and rods, soft shadows, and shallow depth of field.
Layout: Center the title at the top in large dark navy bold type, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="A close-up view of the DNA double helix"} directly beneath in smaller medium-blue type. Fill the frame with a large twisting DNA double helix running from the left foreground through the center to the right side, with a second orange strand crossing diagonally through the lower right foreground. Keep the central base-pair region open and readable for labels.
Subject details: Render the DNA as a molecular ball-and-stick model combined with translucent bead-like backbone surfaces. The sugar-phosphate backbone should be two twisting chains made of semi-transparent bluish-gray spheres with orange/gold connector rods and small red atoms. In the center, show exactly 4 labeled nucleotide bases: Adenine (A) in green at upper left center, Thymine (T) in purple at upper right center, Guanine (G) in blue at lower left center, and Cytosine (C) in orange at lower right center. Adenine pairs with Thymine across the top using dotted pale blue hydrogen bonds, and Guanine pairs with Cytosine below using three dotted pale blue hydrogen-bond rows. Molecular rings should be flat aromatic ring structures with small colored atom spheres and white hydrogen atoms.

Use crisp sans-serif typography and avoid crowding.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed scientific 3D render, glossy translucent molecular beads, realistic refraction, soft bokeh background, professional biology textbook infographic, balanced educational clarity and cinematic depth.
Constraints: Use exactly the 4 nucleotide labels and exactly the 3 structural labels listed above; do not add extra labels, icons, captions, legends, watermarks, or borders. Keep all text sharp and correctly spelled.

blocks.title: No. 42: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Japanese AI Fantasy Image Comparison Slide
blocks.description: Creates a polished Japanese infographic comparing 2025 and 2026 fantasy AI image outputs from the same simple prompt.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a Japanese comparison infographic slide about how AI image generation changes when given only the prompt {argument name="prompt phrase" default="幻想的な画像"}, comparing August 2025 and August 2026 outputs.
Canvas: 4:3 horizontal presentation slide, dark navy gradient background, polished tech-report style. Use crisp white Japanese typography, glowing borders, and subtle blue/purple highlights. Overall mood should feel like a serious visual analysis of fantasy AI art evolution.
Header: At the top center, large bold Japanese title: 「『幻想的な画像』とだけ指示したときの比較」. Directly underneath, smaller subtitle: 「AI画像生成の進化：2025年8月 vs 2026年8月」.
Layout: Use exactly 2 large rounded comparison panels side by side.
- Left panel: blue theme, labeled 「2025年8月（GPT Image / 従来世代）」.
- Right panel: purple theme, labeled 「2026年8月（ChatGPT Images 2.0）」.
Each panel has a pale prompt strip near the top reading 「プロンプト：幻想的な画像」.
Left panel content: Show exactly 1 fantasy artwork: a traditional painterly fantasy landscape with a huge full moon, deep blue night sky, forest silhouettes, a winding glowing river, small firefly-like lights, and a distant dark castle with spires. It should look like a complete single illustration, warm and nostalgic, with a restrained composition.
Below the artwork, create exactly 2 analysis boxes:
1. Box title 「特徴」 with exactly 3 bullet points: 「月・森・城の定番モチーフに収束」, 「全体にやや黄ばんだ暖色の光」, 「シンプルで一枚の完成形として出力」.
2. Box title 「色調の傾向」 with a small horizontal color palette of exactly 4 swatches: deep blue, teal green, warm yellow, golden ocher. Add explanatory text: 「青＋緑＋黄のバランスで、古典的ファンタジー絵画のような温かみのある色調」.
Right panel content: Show exactly 2 fantasy artworks side by side inside the panel, separated by a thin vertical divider.
1. Left artwork: a luminous fantasy city at night with a crescent moon, starry sky, distant towers, glowing waterfront, and a long-haired woman in a flowing dress standing on a balcony or bridge, looking toward the city.
2. Right artwork: an opulent celestial castle floating above clouds, white and lavender architecture, sparkling sky, crystalline towers, pink-purple blossoms, and a small robed figure looking into the glowing city.
The right panel art should feel more complex, cinematic, saturated, and concept-art-like than the left panel.
Below the artworks, create exactly 2 analysis boxes:
1. Box title 「特徴」 with exactly 3 bullet points: 「複数の解釈を提示（2パターン）」, 「天空都市・星空・人物などより多様で壮大な構図」, 「色彩が鮮やかで幻想性が高い」.
2. Box title 「色調の傾向」 with a small horizontal color palette of exactly 5 swatches: cyan blue, violet, pale pink, white, light sky blue. Add explanatory text: 「青＋紫＋ピンク＋白が中心で、デジタルファンタジー／コンセプトアート的な冷色系」.
Bottom summary bar: Across the full width at the bottom, add a rounded dark blue box. On the left, a small label button reading 「まとめ」. To the right, summary text: 「2025年は『典型的な幻想風景を一枚』に収束していたのに対し、2026年は『幻想的』という概念から複数の解釈を生成し、色彩・構図・世界観の幅が大きく拡張している。」
Visual style: Clean Japanese infographic, presentation slide, thin neon blue/purple borders, subtle drop shadows, high readability, balanced margins, precise alignment. Use fantasy images that look like embedded generated examples rather than photographs.
Constraints: Include exactly 3 fantasy artworks total, exactly 2 main comparison panels, exactly 4 analysis boxes, and exactly 2 color palettes. Keep all Japanese text legible and do not add extra labels, logos, watermarks, or irrelevant decorations.

blocks.title: No. 43: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - AI Agent LP Ecosystem Infographic
blocks.description: A wide Japanese isometric workflow infographic showing how an AI agent coordinates planning, research, creation, review, and publication for landing page production.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide 16:9 Japanese isometric infographic explaining an AI-agent ecosystem that completes landing page production through a “command tower” model, with the headline {argument name="headline text" default="AIエージェント：LP制作を完遂する「司令塔」のエコシステム"} across the top.
Canvas: Horizontal slide, light sky-blue background with soft clouds, simple city-map roads, tiny trees, pedestrians, cars, and technology buildings. Use a clean blue, cyan, white, and black palette with thick rounded vector outlines, friendly SaaS/tech illustration style, crisp readable labels, and subtle halftone texture. No photorealism.
Layout: Center a large circular roundabout containing the main AI Agent command-center building, with a domed roof, clock, gears, and brain icon. Around it place exactly 4 main workflow buildings/cards connected by roads and directional arrows: 1) PLAN at upper left, 2) RESEARCH at upper right, 3) CREATE at lower left, 4) TEST & APPROVE at lower right. Add a final publication destination on the far right: a storefront labeled as the publishing/operation start point with a rocket launch building nearby. Include supporting city objects: exactly 3 satellite dishes on the research building roof area, exactly 3 database/server stack icons near the upper right, exactly 2 tall office towers at the far right, exactly 1 small bank/store building at far upper left, exactly 1 office block at bottom left, and exactly 1 foreground dome building at bottom center.
Text content: Use Japanese text throughout. Top title must read {argument name="headline text" default="AIエージェント：LP制作を完遂する「司令塔」のエコシステム"}. Central circle label: “AI AGENT：理解・計画・判断を担う中心地”. Inside the central building, add a small panel saying the agent understands user goals and automatically assembles necessary tasks. Left side user note: “ユーザー依頼：LPを作って！”
Sections: Show exactly 4 labeled production modules with these visible labels and contents. PLAN module: title “PLAN：依頼を5つのタスクへ分解”; list exactly 5 numbered items: 1 調査, 2 構成, 3 制作, 4 検証, 5 公開; add a caption saying the request is decomposed into five tasks and execution priority is determined. RESEARCH module: title “RESEARCH：外部と内部の情報を統合”; show exactly 2 content icons labeled “Webデータ” and “内部資料”; caption about integrating competitor, market, and internal product information. CREATE module: title “CREATE：複数ツールの使い分け”; show exactly 3 tool icons labeled “キャッチコピー AIライティング”, “画像生成 AIデザイン”, and “コーディング AI開発”; caption saying copy, images, and coding are produced using appropriate specialized tools. TEST & APPROVE module: title “TEST & APPROVE：品質検証と人間の承認”; show exactly 3 verification icons: an AI chip, a checked monitor, and people/approval; include labels for display check, quality check, and brand/person-in-charge approval; caption saying AI handles display and quality checks and the final human approval begins publication.
Subject details: Roads should visually connect every module to the central AI Agent hub, emphasizing relationships rather than a strict linear flow. Place the publish destination on the right with an arrow leading to a striped storefront labeled “公開・運用開始”. Add small decorative tech details such as antennas, document icons, code brackets, magnifying glass, gears, cloud shapes, and tiny people walking between buildings, but keep them secondary.
Style constraints: Isometric 2.5D diagram, flat vector illustration, blue monochrome emphasis, black outlines, clean infographic composition, high legibility, no watermark except a tiny unobtrusive “Gemini Notebook” style credit in the bottom right if needed. Keep all labels compact and aligned inside white rounded panels.

blocks.title: No. 44: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Dark Fantasy Worldbuilding Board
blocks.description: A cinematic grid presentation showing a consistent medieval archer character, snowy locations, and props for worldbuilding or image-generation showcases.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic presentation board for a worldbuilding / image-generation workflow, showing how a consistent fantasy character, locations, and props are built image by image.
Canvas: Wide 4:3 composition on a nearly black background with rounded rectangular cards arranged in a clean grid, soft gaps, subtle shadows, and a muted premium UI feel.
Layout: Use exactly 6 visible cards. Card 1 is a tall text card on the upper left. Card 2 is a large wide character card on the upper right. Cards 3 and 4 are two medium landscape location cards across the middle row. Cards 5 and 6 are two smaller prop cards along the lower left and lower center, with a third lower-right character card partially visible/cropped at the edge if the canvas framing allows. Each image card has a small dark pill label in the top-left corner.
Text content: On the upper-left text card, include small spaced uppercase text “ONE WORLD” near the top. In the lower half, include the headline “Built image by image” and the body text “A character, her locations, and the props she carries — generated separately, holding one look.” Use clean modern sans-serif typography, white headline, muted gray body text.
Visible labeled image cards: 5 fully visible labeled image cards plus 1 text card. The labels are: 2 cards labeled “Character,” 2 cards labeled “Location,” and 2 cards labeled “Prop” if the lower-right crop is included; otherwise keep the main visible set as 1 Character, 2 Location, and 2 Prop. Do not add extra labels.
Subject details: The main character is {argument name="character description" default="a pale young blonde medieval archer girl with braided hair, serious expression, wool cloak and leather quiver of arrows"}. Place her in a snowy stone castle courtyard, holding a long wooden bow, with cold blue-gray lighting and shallow cinematic depth of field. The locations show {argument name="world setting" default="a grim Nordic medieval winter world"}: one frozen harbor with Viking-style longships trapped in ice, torchlight, mountains and snow; one fortified snowy military camp with tents, wooden palisades, watchtowers, smoke rising, and stormy clouds. The props show exactly 2 close-up items: a weathered leather pouch or wrist guard marked with pale runic symbols and small bones, and a row of antler or horn pieces in snow with blurred background.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic dark fantasy, desaturated blue-gray winter palette, falling snow, realistic textures, high detail, moody natural lighting, consistent medieval wardrobe and materials across all cards. Rounded card corners, elegant spacing, no bright colors.
Constraints: Keep the interface minimal and editorial, like a premium AI image-generation case study. Preserve the exact headline and body copy. Avoid logos, watermarks, charts, anime style, modern objects, or extra UI clutter.

blocks.title: No. 45: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Four Cloudflare WebMCP Infographic Posters

Each page has a clean white background, rounded pastel section boxes, colored headers, small icons, arrows, and a bottom-right semi-transparent dark rounded button overlay on some pages.

1. Left page: Title “Cloudflare WebMCPとは?” with orange “WebMCP”, subtitle about WebMCP as a bridge connecting web sites and AI agents. Include exactly 6 numbered horizontal sections: 1) “WebMCPって何?” with a simple web page to AI-agent diagram and green “ポイント” bullets; 2) “なぜ必要なの?” with red X problem bullets and orange solution bullets; 3) “WebMCPの仕組み” with a 5-step icon flow; 4) “Webサイト側の実装イメージ” with a dark code snippet block on the left and benefit cards on the right; 5) “セキュリティ” with green checklist and Chrome/WebMCP tool card; 6) “まとめ: WebMCPのメリット” with four benefit icons.
2. Second page: Title “Cloudflare WebMCPとは?” with a small orange Cloudflare logo and explanatory paragraph. Include exactly 5 numbered sections: 1) “WebMCPとは?” showing AI agent, web application, and Cloudflare WebMCP connection; 2) “仕組み: WebMCPはどのように動作する?” with a left-to-right flow from AI agent to WebMCP endpoint to user approval to tool execution; 3) “Cloudflare が WebMCP を簡単にできる理由” with purple feature cards and a code snippet; 4) “導入の流れ” with orange step cards for Workers/Pages, API definition, endpoint, MCP setup, and AI use; 5) “セキュリティと権限の考え方” with red warning/security cards. Add a dark pill overlay at lower right reading “もっと生成”.
3. Third page: Title “Cloudflare WebMCPとは?” with subtitle about publishing tools on web sites for AI agents. Include exactly 7 numbered sections with compact cards: 1) “WebMCPの主な概念” with three cards for AI agent, WebMCP, and security/permission; 2) “Cloudflareが提供するWebMCPの仕組み” with a detailed architecture diagram using browser, Cloudflare, worker, API, and data-store icons; 3) “WebMCPの活用例” with multiple small use-case cards; 4) “なぜCloudflareでWebMCPが使いやすい?” in an orange band with benefit icons; 5) “実装例: シンプルなサイト連携” with a small form/table and tool cards; 6) “導入ステップ” with a 5-step horizontal flow; 7) “セキュリティのポイント” with green checklist cards. Add a dark pill overlay near the bottom reading “さらに深く考える”.
4. Right page: Title “Cloudflare WebMCPとは?” with an orange Cloudflare logo and a small browser/address-bar illustration at top right plus an AI agent icon. Include exactly 6 numbered sections: 1) “WebMCPとは?” with definition bullets and a diagram from web app to AI agent; 2) “なぜCloudflareがWebMCPを推進している?” with exactly 4 cards describing AI-friendly web, security, open standards, and Cloudflare ecosystem; 3) “WebMCPの仕組み” with exactly 5 icon steps from site/API to MCP endpoint to AI request to tool execution to result; 4) “WebMCP manifest のイメージ” with a dark code block and a green checklist card; 5) “セキュリティとして重要” with warning and permission cards; 6) “まとめ: WebMCPの価値” with four blue/purple benefit cards.
Text content: The main headline on every page must include {argument name="headline text" default="Cloudflare WebMCPとは?"}. Keep all visible body text in Japanese. Use credible Japanese labels such as “AIエージェント”, “Webサイト”, “MCPサーバー”, “ツール定義”, “認可”, “権限管理”, “Workers”, “Pages”, “API”, “manifest”, “セキュリティ”, and “導入ステップ”. Use tiny text where necessary but keep major section titles legible.
Branding and colors: Use {argument name="brand name" default="Cloudflare"} branding, orange cloud logos, blue section headers, green success boxes, orange highlight boxes, purple feature boxes, red security/warning boxes, and gray explanatory cards. Maintain a professional Japanese tech-blog infographic aesthetic.
Constraints: Show exactly 4 pages, exactly 6 sections on page 1, 5 sections on page 2, 7 sections on page 3, and 6 sections on page 4. Do not include people or photorealistic scenes. Do not add watermarks. Make the image information-dense, like a generated social-media comparison of four alternate infographic designs.
